lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# #82 — `read` resolves a missing path against the algorithms store before calling it absent, reusing
# the SAME lookup `bsc graph harvest` uses (#75) rather than restating it here. A retired module's file
# is deliberately gone, so the filesystem alone is the wrong thing to answer with.
# ripgrep's directory walker: respects .gitignore/.ignore + skips hidden/.git by default, follows no
# symlinks (avoids the node_modules junction hazard), and yields per-entry metadata for file sizes.
